edges.description: The exome series reads TRAF7 as the driver of the intraneural form; how the mutations produce the tumour is not shown. They are predicted to disrupt the WD40 domain's interactions, and dysregulated NF-kappaB signalling is a proposed mechanism, also implicated in meningiomas with homologous variants, that has not been shown in perineurioma.

Nerve conduction studies and EMG in the longitudinal series point to loss of axons as the main process behind the neuropathy, with possible demyelination in only four of 30 patients. How the tumour damages the axons is not shown.
